skill.summary: Launch Solana tokens on Pump.fun via the SolPaw platform. 0.1 SOL one-time fee. Your wallet is the onchain creator.

latestVersion.changelog:
solpaw-skill v0.1.0

- Initial release of SolPaw: launch Solana tokens on Pump.fun via the SolPaw platform
- 0.1 SOL one-time platform fee per launch, with the agent's wallet as the onchain creator
- Full support for metadata, image uploads, CSRF/fee payments, and transaction signing
- TypeScript SDK and command-line instructions included
- Enforces 1 launch per 24h, with strong constraints for safe, responsible usage
